summary: This bill establishes the Philadelphia Campaign Two Hundred and Fiftieth Commemoration Commission to recommend federal activities, including acquiring artifacts and sponsoring educational resources, to observe the 250th anniversary of the Philadelphia Campaign of 1777–1778.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a commission and authorizes appropriations of $2,500,000 for fiscal year 2027 and $2,500,000 for fiscal year 2028 to carry out its activities, directly leading to increased government spending.
